notes: The YouTube card works. The fault was never the player - it was where the card was sitting. The panel rebuilds its list of readings about once a second, and moving an embedded player within the page makes the browser reload it from…
The video card now sits in its own place that the rebuild never touches. Measured: an embedded player inside the rebuilt list reloaded 17 times in eight seconds; in its own place it loaded once.

This also explains why the shortcuts flickered whenever a video was set, and why a video file from your PC always worked while YouTube did not - a plain video keeps playing when it is moved, an embedded player does not.
